battle.name: 阿爾及利亞內戰
battle.brief: 阿爾及利亞內戰於1991年12月在阿爾及利亞爆發，阿爾及爾等地出現政府軍與武裝反對派的持續對抗。這場衝突以國家內部的政治、軍事分裂為背景；別丹步槍（Berdan rifle，1866年）則是俄羅斯帝國陸軍制式步槍，蘇聯時期仍沿用，並在1991年前已完成列裝。

kit.name: 別丹步槍
kit.history: 別丹步槍是俄羅斯帝國陸軍的制式步槍，後由蘇聯軍隊沿用，配置於步兵連隊，作為標準步兵武器執行射擊任務。

countries: 這場衝突的法定交戰方是阿爾及利亞人民民族軍，內政部轄屬治安警察與國家憲兵隊共同構成政府一方；反政府力量並非一支連續運作的統一軍隊。1991年伊斯蘭救國陣線遭取締後，原有武裝骨幹在1992年分化為以攻擊治安機關為主的伊斯蘭救援軍（AIS），以及主張以武裝鬥爭建立伊斯蘭國家的伊斯蘭抵抗軍（AAR）；後者部分單位在1993至1994年間演成武裝伊斯蘭團體（GIA）。主要戰場由北部沿海都會區延伸至阿爾及爾高原、阿特拉斯山區與東部高地，阿爾及爾、君士坦丁及貝沙等交通樞紐連接主要補給線。法國提供情報與外交支持，並未派正規部隊參戰；摩洛哥及利比亞方向因越境滲透與軍火流動，成為邊境監視重點。
countriesEn: The legally constituted belligerent in this conflict was the Algerian People's National Army, while the Forces de sécurité under the Ministry of Interior and the National Gendarmerie formed the rest of the government side; the anti-government forces were never a single continuously operating army. After the Islamic Salvation Front was banned in 1991, its armed cadre fragmented in 1992 into the Islamic Salvation Army (AIS), which concentrated on security targets, and the Islamic Resistance Army (AAR), which sought to establish an Islamic state through armed struggle. Parts of the latter evolved into the Armed Islamic Group (GIA) between 1993 and 1994. The principal theatre extended from the northern coastal urban zone across the Algerian highlands, the Atlas Mountains and the eastern uplands, with Algiers, Constantine and Bézéa linking the principal supply routes. France supplied intelligence and diplomatic support without deploying regular forces, while the borders toward Morocco and Libya became major surveillance priorities because of cross-border infiltration and arms movement.
people: 1991年4月23日，陸軍少將穆罕默德·阿明·烏爾德·謝里夫（Mohamedamine Ould Cherif）進入新組成的最高安全委員會，總統查德利·本杰迪德（Chadli Bendjedid）與總理西德·艾哈邁德·加扎利（Sid Ahmed Ghozali）亦為核心成員。救國陣線主席阿卜杜勒卡德爾·哈查尼於6月被捕。政府在1992年1月12日取消議會選舉後，本杰迪德於1月16日辭職，阿里·卡菲（Ali Kafi）出任代理國家元首；穆罕默德·拉馬里（Mohamed Lamari）同年接掌軍隊參謀長。1993年1月，穆罕默德·布迪亞夫（Mohamed Boudiaf）當選國家元首，並於1994年6月29日遇刺身亡；1996年1月9日，卡菲當選總統。阿卜杜勒阿齊茲·布特弗利卡（Abdelaziz Bouteflika）於1999年12月就任，艾哈邁德·蓋德·薩拉赫（Ahmed Gaid Salah）先後主管軍方情報工作並在2002年接任參謀長。反政府一方沒有長期固定的單一指揮官，伊斯蘭救援軍、伊斯蘭抵抗軍及GIA各有區域性指揮層，最後由阿卜杜勒馬吉德·梅齊安（Abdelmadjid Meziane）代表伊斯蘭救援軍宣布停火。
peopleEn: On 23 April 1991, Major General Mohamedamine Ould Cherif joined the newly formed High Security Council, with President Chadli Bendjedid and Prime Minister Sid Ahmed Ghozali as its other central members. Islamic Salvation Front chairman Abdelkader Hachani was arrested in June. After the parliamentary election was cancelled on 12 January 1992, Bendjedid resigned on 16 January, and Ali Kafi became acting head of state; Mohamed Lamari took command of the army staff during the same year. Mohamed Boudiaf was elected head of state in January 1993 and was assassinated on 29 June 1994. Kafi was elected president on 9 January 1996. Abdelaziz Bouteflika took office in December 1999, while Ahmed Gaid Salah headed military intelligence before becoming chief of staff in 2002. The insurgent side lacked a permanent unified commander: the AIS, AAR and GIA maintained regional command structures, and Abdelmadjid Meziane ultimately declared the ceasefire on behalf of the AIS.
kits: 政府軍的骨幹裝備包括蘇制AK-47、AKM與AK-74步槍、PKM通用機槍、RPG-7火箭筒、FN FAL 7.62毫米步槍，以及9×18毫米PM-83馬卡羅夫手槍；裝甲與火力支援裝備包括T-55坦克、BTR-60PB裝甲運兵車、BRDM-2輪式裝甲車、2S1「金雀花」122毫米自走榴炮、MiG-21戰鬥機、Mi-8／Mi-17運輸直升機與Mi-24攻擊直升機。主要彈藥口徑包括7.62×39毫米、7.62×51毫米、9×18毫米與5.45×39毫米，坦克及車炮另使用115毫米與14.5毫米彈藥。反政府武裝同樣使用AK-47、AKM、AK-74、FN FAL、UZI衝鋒槍、PKM及RPG-7，並以Toyota Hilux越野車執行快速轉移與撤退。下列型號在1991年以前均已正式列裝；政府一方在制式彈藥、燃料、裝甲與航空兵力上占優勢，武裝一方則依靠小單位分散、分散式儲存與較低的持續消耗維持行動。
kitsEn: The government forces' core inventory included Soviet AK-47, AKM and AK-74 rifles, PKM general-purpose machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, FN FAL 7.62 mm rifles and 9×18 mm PM-83 Makarov pistols. Armoured and fire-support equipment included T-55 tanks, BTR-60PB armoured personnel carriers, BRDM-2 wheeled armoured cars, 2S1 Gvozdika 122 mm self-propelled guns, MiG-21 fighters, Mi-8 and Mi-17 transport helicopters, and Mi-24 attack helicopters. Principal ammunition calibres included 7.62×39 mm, 7.62×51 mm, 9×18 mm and 5.45×39 mm, with separate 115 mm and 14.5 mm rounds for tanks and armoured fighting vehicles. The insurgents also used AK-47, AKM and AK-74 rifles, FN FAL rifles, Uzi submachine guns, PKM machine guns and RPG-7 launchers, while Toyota Hilux utility vehicles provided rapid mobility and withdrawal. Every listed model had entered service before 1991. The government held the material advantage in standardized ammunition, fuel, armour and aviation, while the armed groups sustained operations through small dispersed units, distributed storage and lower continuous consumption.
tactics: 政府最初以治安警察和國家憲兵執行封鎖、搜查、拘押與審訊，並查封救國陣線辦事處；武裝衝突擴大後，則結合宵禁、路障、固定檢查點、裝甲車巡邏及直升機突擊掃蕩。Mi-8／Mi-17負責補給與指揮節點轉移，Mi-24提供近距火力，2S1則可支援山區封鎖和間接射擊。反政府小隊避免長時間正面交戰，通常以夜襲、伏擊巡邏和孤立哨所攻擊消耗治安部隊，再在追兵抵達前分散撤入崎嶇地形；武器、燃料及通信器材分藏於小型據點，後續行動依賴簡短通信與區域性情報網。伊斯蘭救援軍偏重攻擊治安機關，伊斯蘭抵抗軍及後來的GIA則把軍政、警政和外交目標列為重點，並在城市與山區之間建立游擊網。政府的後期戰略並非單純清剿，而是軍事壓力、1997年停火談判、1998年與2000年特赦，以及對不同武裝派別採取差別待遇並行。
tacticsEn: The government initially relied on the security police and National Gendarmerie for cordons, searches, detention and interrogation, including the seizure of Islamic Salvation Front offices. As armed conflict expanded, it combined curfews, roadblocks, permanent checkpoints, armoured patrols and helicopter raids. Mi-8 and Mi-17 helicopters moved supplies and command nodes, Mi-24 helicopters provided close fire support, and 2S1 guns could support mountain isolations and indirect fire. insurgent squads avoided prolonged conventional engagements. They generally conducted night raids, ambushes of patrols and attacks on isolated posts, then dispersed into rugged terrain before reinforcements arrived. Weapons, fuel and communications equipment were held in small caches, with later operations depending on brief communications and regional intelligence networks. The AIS concentrated on security targets, while the AAR and later GIA gave priority to military, police and diplomatic targets and developed guerrilla networks linking urban and mountain areas. The government's later strategy was not simple clearance alone, but military pressure combined with the 1997 ceasefire negotiations, the 1998 and 2000 amnesty measures and differentiated treatment of armed factions.
data: 本紀錄把1991年4月的高級安全委員會成立視為內戰的制度起點，以2002年9月21日停火為終點；1991年的公開政治衝突與鎮壓是開端，成熟游擊戰則在1992年成形。1988年全國性衝突後，政府於1989年恢復多黨政治；1990年4月地方選舉及6月議會選舉中，伊斯蘭救國陣線成為最大政治力量。1991年2月16日「黑色星期四」示威擴散至多座城鎮；4月23日加扎利出任總理，4月26日成立高級安全委員會。5月至6月進行全面拘捕與搜查，6月初查封救國陣線總部並正式取締其組織；9月實施首輪大赦。12月3日舉行憲法公投，十一項修正案獲准，官方統計投票率約60.7％、贊成約82.9％，救國陣線拒絕參與。1992年1月12日議會選舉因暴力與低投票率被取消，1月16日本杰迪德辭職；同年AIS與AAR分立。1993年1月布迪亞夫當選國家元首，1994年6月29日遇刺身亡；1996年1月9日卡菲當選總統，1995年至1996年的安全重組則加強軍方主導的指揮體系。1997年9月21日政府與AIS達成停火安排，1998年2月9日通過特赦法，1999年12月布特弗利卡就任總統，2000年9月13日再以和解及特赦法處理部分武裝人員。2002年7月5日總統選舉後，9月21日梅齊安宣布停火。因戰時通報、地下組織宣傳與事後研究的口徑並不一致，本紀錄不列出任何未經確定的總傷亡數字。
dataEn: This account treats the formation of the High Security Council in April 1991 as the institutional beginning of the civil war and the ceasefire of 21 September 2002 as its conclusion; the open political conflict and crackdown of 1991 formed the opening, while a mature guerrilla war developed in 1992. Following nationwide disturbances in 1988, the government restored multiparty politics in 1989. The Islamic Salvation Front became the largest political force in the April 1990 local elections and June legislative election. The Black Thursday demonstrations of 16 February 1991 spread to several cities; Sid Ahmed Ghozali became prime minister on 23 April, and the High Security Council was created on 26 April. Mass arrests and searches followed from May through June; the movement's headquarters was seized and the organisation formally banned in early June, followed by a first amnesty in September. A constitutional referendum was held on 3 December. Eleven amendments were approved, with an official turnout of about 60.7 percent and approval of about 82.9 percent, while the Islamic Salvation Front boycotted the vote. The parliamentary election was cancelled on 12 January 1992 because of violence and low participation, and Bendjedid resigned on 16 January; the AIS and AAR separated during that year. Boudiaf was elected head of state in January 1993 and assassinated on 29 June 1994. Kafi became president on 9 January 1996, after security reorganisations in 1995 and 1996 strengthened military control of the command system. The government reached a ceasefire arrangement with the AIS on 21 September 1997, and an amnesty law followed on 9 February 1998. Bouteflika took office in December 1999, while another reconciliation and amnesty law was adopted on 13 September 2000. After the presidential election of 5 July 2002, Meziane declared the ceasefire on 21 September. Because wartime reports, underground propaganda and later studies used inconsistent counting conventions, no unverified aggregate casualty total is given here.
cause: 內戰的根源不是單一事件，而是三層因素疊加。1980年代中期油價下跌削弱國家的財政收入，一黨時期形成的資源分配、行政任人唯親與地區差距同時顯現；1989年開放政黨後，伊斯蘭救國陣線又迅速取得1990年選舉優勢，使世俗軍政體制面對可能失去國家最高權位的現實。政治黨派與社團法律、世俗國家原則及治理方式上的衝突，在1991年2月的示威中集中爆發。政府先禁止集會，再由軍方主導全國性拘捕、查封與取締救國陣線，使原本在議會和合法組織內競爭的勢力失去公開活動空間，一部分策劃者轉入地下，準備武裝抵抗。1992年1月12日取消議會選舉是直接引爆點：選舉原本可以重新分配政治權力，遭到取消後，國家安全會議選擇以鎮壓和軍事管理代替政治協商，合法政治衝突遂轉成游擊戰與反國家暴力。
causeEn: The civil war arose from the convergence of three layers rather than a single incident. The oil-price decline of the mid-1980s weakened state finances, while the unequal distribution of resources, administrative patronage and regional disparities inherited from one-party rule became increasingly visible. After political parties were permitted in 1989, the Islamic Salvation Front rapidly dominated the 1990 elections, confronting the secular military-political establishment with the possibility of losing supreme state power. Conflict over party and association law, the secular character of the state and the methods of governance erupted in the February 1991 demonstrations. The authorities first banned assemblies, then directed nationwide arrests, office seizures and the banning of the Islamic Salvation Front through a military-led campaign. This removed the legal arena in which the movement had been competing through parliament and lawful organisations, while some organisers went underground and prepared armed resistance. The cancellation of the parliamentary election on 12 January 1992 was the immediate trigger. That election could have redistributed political authority; once it was cancelled, the High Security Council chose repression and military administration instead of political negotiation, transforming a legal political conflict into guerrilla warfare and anti-state violence.
impact: 第一項影響是國家權力結構 militarised：高級安全委員會、緊急法律與軍事情報單位逐漸凌駕一般政黨程序，總理與內政部門的人事更替加快，政治競爭則受到嚴格限制。第二項影響是軍隊任務由邊防防衛轉向國內安全；固定崗哨、路障、裝甲巡邏與直升機突擊成為長期部署，阿爾及爾高原和山區則反覆進行搜索、封鎖與游擊打擊。第三項影響是反政府組織分裂：救國陣線原有的政治領導、原來的武裝單位及新建立的游擊小隊彼此失去統一控制，GIA部分派系把軍政與外交目標列為重點，促使法國以情報合作和外交施壓介入，阿爾及爾—利比亞邊境也受到更高密度監察。第四項影響是雙方都無法取得一次會戰式的決定性勝利，政府必須以軍事壓力配合談判和特赦，分化原本具有共同鬥爭經驗的武裝派別。戰後評估因此不能只按戰線推移判斷，而須同時觀察政治合法性、軍隊控制、派別分裂及外交關係的變化；由於各方記錄標準不一，總傷亡數字不宜用單一精確數字概括。
impactEn: The first effect was the militarisation of the state structure. The High Security Council, emergency legislation and military intelligence units gradually displaced normal party procedures; personnel changes in the prime minister's office and Ministry of Interior became frequent, while political competition was tightly restricted. The second effect was the army's shift from border defence toward domestic security. Permanent posts, roadblocks, armoured patrols and helicopter raids became permanent arrangements, with repeated searches, isolations and guerrilla operations in the Algerian highlands and mountain regions. The third effect was the fragmentation of the insurgents. The movement's political leadership, former armed cadre and newly formed guerrilla cells lost unified control, while parts of the GIA prioritised military, police and diplomatic targets. This encouraged French intelligence cooperation and diplomatic pressure and produced denser surveillance of the Algerian-Libyan frontier. The fourth effect was that neither side could achieve a decisive conventional victory. The government had to combine military pressure with negotiations and amnesties, dividing groups that had previously shared a common struggle. Postwar assessment therefore cannot rely on front-line movement alone; it must also examine political legitimacy, military control, factional fragmentation and diplomatic relationships. Because the parties used inconsistent recording standards, total casualties should not be reduced to a single precise figure.
result: 法定終點是2002年9月21日宣布的停火。梅齊安代表伊斯蘭救援軍同意停止武裝鬥爭後，主要武裝派別接受停火及分階段解除武裝，2003年原伊斯蘭救援軍的人員另以伊斯蘭救國運動（AMN）參與合法政治活動。政府方的2000年和解及特赦法讓部分前武裝人員重新取得法律身分，但明確排除了涉及重大殺傷的案件，因此不是無條件特赦。GIA在此前已分裂成互相競爭的地區派別，部分武裝人員在2002年後仍以小型組織活動，故停火不能解讀為所有殘餘武裝已被消滅。戰爭結果不是政府軍在戰場上全殲反對派，而是政府控制主要 territory、完成有限度政治整合、分別處理願意解除武裝與拒絕合作的派別，再由停火建立新秩序。軍方在危機時期的制度地位因此提高，但議會選舉與政黨活動仍受嚴格規範；阿爾及利亞由此結束1991年開始的內戰階段，轉入以軍方影響力、有限政治競爭和持續反恐安全措施並存的時期。
resultEn: The formal endpoint was the ceasefire announced on 21 September 2002. After Meziane spoke on behalf of the Islamic Salvation Army and agreed to stop armed struggle, the principal armed groups accepted the ceasefire and phased disarmament; in 2003, former Islamic Salvation Army personnel entered legal politics through the Islamic Salvation Movement (AMN). The government's Reconciliation and Amnesty Law of 2000 allowed some former militants to regain legal status, but it expressly excluded those responsible for grave killings and was therefore not unconditional. The GIA had already fragmented into competing regional groups, and some armed personnel continued as small organisations after 2002, so the ceasefire cannot be interpreted as the complete destruction of every remnant. The outcome was not a battlefield annihilation of the opposition. The government retained control of the main territory, carried out a limited political integration, treated groups willing to disarm separately from those refusing cooperation, and then established a new order through the ceasefire. The military consequently strengthened its institutional position during the crisis, although parliamentary elections and party activity remained strictly regulated. Algeria thereby ended the phase of civil war that began in 1991 and entered a period combining military influence, limited political competition and continuing counter-insurgency security measures.
